name: GlobalSecureAccessOnboard
label: Onboard Global Secure Access
helpText: Connects the tenant to Microsoft's Global Secure Access service. Required before the other Global Secure Access standards work. Onboarding is permanent - undoing it needs Microsoft support - but no traffic changes until the client is deployed. Requires Entra ID P1 or P2.
executiveText: Signs the tenant up for Microsoft's cloud network security service. Nothing changes for users yet.
docsDescription: Checks whether the tenant is onboarded to Global Secure Access and starts onboarding if needed. Onboarding takes a few minutes; the next run confirms it finished.
